Name: Stardew Valley Multiplayer Unattended Server Mod
Author: popwqoq
Description:
[size=6][b]Stardew Valley Multiplayer/Unattended Server Mod（无人值守服务器mod）[/b]
[/size]
[size=3]这是一个“无人值守多人游戏服务器”模组，由[b][u]机器人代替玩家作为游戏主机[/u][/b]（因此建议使用小号）使得游戏世界始终处于在线状态！可以允许其他玩家随时加入而不受其他客观因素限制！
[/size][size=3]An Unattended Multiplayer Server Mod​​ that uses bots as the host (recommended to use an alt account!), keeping the game world ​​online 24/7!​​ Enables other players to ​​join anytime, anywhere​​, bypassing normal hosting restrictions![/size]


[size=6]如何安装 How to Install：[/size]
[size=3]
[list]
[*][size=3]安装 SMAPI：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400[/url][/size]
[/list]       Install SMAPI: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400[/url][list]
[*][size=3]将“Stardew Valley Multiplayer Unattended Server Mod”文件夹放在 Stardew Valley 游戏目录中的“Mods”文件夹中。[/size]
[/list] ﻿Place the “Stardew Valley Multiplayer Unattended Server Mod”folder inside the "Mods" folder in your Stardew Valley game directory.[list]
[*][size=3]通过 “StardewModdingAPI.exe” 启动游戏。[/size]
[/list] ﻿Launch the game via "StardewModdingAPI.exe".[/size]


[size=6]如何使用 How to Use：
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]在开始游戏之前，将设置更改为更加适合你的游戏的设置[/size]
[/list][size=3] ﻿Tweak the settings before starting the game to better fit your playstyle!
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]主持多人游戏。服务器 Mod 将在游戏开始时自动启动。你可以按设置的快捷键选择是否开启mod！[/size]
[/list][size=3] ﻿​​Host multiplayer games. The server mod launches automatically at game startup. Toggle your server on/off anytime using the configured hotkey!​

[list]
[*][size=3]注意：游戏窗口可以不被聚焦 但是请不要最小化！否则会影响mod和游戏运行！[/size]
[/list][/size] ﻿Warning: The game window doesn't need focus, but DO NOT minimize it! This will disrupt mod and game functionality![size=3] ﻿

[/size][size=6]设置 Settings ：
[/size]
[size=3]编辑“config.json” 文件以设置您的选项：
[/size]Edit the "config.json" file to set your options:

[b][size=3] ﻿“serverHotKey”： “F9”， ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿     启动/停止服务器的按钮 (which button to start/stop server)
﻿“profitmargin” ： 100， ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ 利润率百分比 (Profit Margin in percent)
﻿“autoLevel”： true， ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿      是否自动升级为10级(When the server is activated is the host auto-leveled to 10)
﻿“upgradeHouse”： 3， ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿  主屋等级 3 为最高 0为初始(Upgrades the main house. 3 is max level, 0 will do nothing)
﻿“petname”： “” ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿  宠物名字（[size=3]petname[/size]）
﻿“farmcavechoicemushrooms”： true，                ﻿[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3]农场洞穴类型 true是蘑菇、false是蝙蝠 运行前选择(t[size=3][size=3]rue is mushroom, false will be bats, choose before run)

﻿“communitycenterrun”： true， ﻿ ﻿ ﻿       玩法流派 true会尝试社区路线，false为joja（true is CC，false is Joja）
﻿“timeOfDayToSleep”： 2200， ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ bot睡觉时间（Bot Sleep Schedule）
﻿ ﻿"lockPlayerChests": true,                         ﻿ ﻿ ﻿玩家宝箱锁 开启后其他玩家无法访问私人宝箱(while servermode is on, players can not access the chests or inventory in other player's cabins.)

﻿ “clientsCanPause”： false，[size=3]                             ﻿    在聊天中键入 ！pause/！unpause暂停游戏
﻿“copyInviteCodeToClipboard”： true， ﻿ ﻿     每分钟将当前邀请码复制到您计算机的剪贴板一次(copies current invite code to your computer's clipboard once a minute)

﻿“festivalsOn”： true，                                                     Bot是否前往节日
﻿“eventname>CountDownConfig”： 60，                节日开始到主活动的准备时间（以秒为单位）(how long in seconds from the start of the festival until it's main event)


[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/b]
[size=6][b]聊天命令  [size=3][size=6]Chat Commands：

[/size][/size][/b][/size][size=3]如果游戏卡住，玩家可以在聊天中输入这些内容尝试：
Clients can type these into chat if the game gets stuck.

[list]
[*][b]!sleep - 如果超过配置的休眠时间（默认为 10PM），则尝试触发 sleep 命令
[/b]
[/list][/size][b] ﻿!sleep - tries to trigger the sleep command if it's past the config sleep time (default 10PM)
[list]
[*]!festival - 如果是节日，则尝试触发 go-to-festival 命令
[/list] ﻿!festival - tries to trigger the go-to-festival command if it is a festival day[list]
[*]!event - 尝试触发命令以启动节日的主事件

[/list] ﻿!event - tries to trigger the command to start the main event of a festival[list]
[*]!leave - 将尝试离开 Festival

[/list] ﻿!leave - will attempt to leave a festival[list]
[*]!unstick - 将主机传送农舍内部/外部

[/list] ﻿!unstick - will warp the host inside/outside the farmhouse[/b]
